review_candidates.title: Personal Assistant
review_candidates.description: The position serves as a trusted and highly organized point person for the day-to-day management and coordination of the family’s personal affairs, schedules, travel arrangements, household requirements, family activities, properties, vehicles, household staff, payments, and other personal administrative matters. The role requires a high level of confidentiality, discretion, integrity, initiative, attention to detail, and reliability, as the position will have access to sensitive personal, financial, family, and business-related information.   KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: A.  Executive and Personal Assistance Manage and coordinate the CEO/President’s personal schedule, appointments, commitments, and activities. Handle personal errands and administrative requests of the CEO/President. Coordinate personal appointments, reservations, meetings, and engagements. Assist in organizing personal-related travel requirements. Anticipate the CEO/President’s personal needs and proactively coordinate necessary arrangements. Maintain organized records of personal schedules, commitments, documents, and important dates. Handle sensitive and confidential information with utmost discretion. B.  Travel and Transportation Management Arrange domestic and international travel plans, including: Airline bookings Hotel accommodations Ground transportation Airport transfers Visa requirements Travel insurance Itineraries Restaurant and activity reservations, when required Prepare comprehensive travel itineraries and supporting documents. Coordinate changes, cancellations, rebooking, and other travel-related concerns. Coordinate transportation requirements for the CEO, family members, and guests. Ensure drivers are properly scheduled for airport transfers, personal appointments, school activities, and other commitments. C.  Family and Children’s Affairs Manage and coordinate schedules and appointments of family members and children. Coordinate children’s school activities, appointments, events, extracurricular activities, and other commitments. Monitor school-related requirements, payments, activities, and deadlines. Coordinate transportation and driver requirements for children’s activities. Assist in arranging supplies, materials, uniforms, activities, and other family requirements. Maintain an updated family calendar to ensure all schedules and commitments are properly coordinated. D.  Household Administration Coordinate the day-to-day administrative requirements of the household. Manage grocery, market, household supplies, and other household purchases. Monitor household inventory and ensure essential supplies are replenished on time. Coordinate payment of household utilities, bills, subscriptions, and other recurring expenses. Maintain proper records of household expenses and payments. Manage household petty cash and ensure proper documentation of all disbursements. Coordinate household repairs, maintenance, service providers, and other requirements. E.  Household Staff Administration Prepare and maintain payslips and payment records for household helpers. Coordinate monthly government remittances and related compliance requirements for household staff, including SSS, Pag-IBIG, and PhilHealth. Maintain accurate records of household staff schedules, compensation, benefits, and other administrative matters. Coordinate day-to-day operations of Kasambahays and Yayas Coordinate schedules, assignments, overtime, official business, and other requirements of household drivers. Monitor and manage driver-related petty cash and expense documentation. Coordinate with household staff to ensure assigned responsibilities and schedules are properly carried out. F. Property and Maintenance Management Monitor the maintenance schedules of the residence and other family properties. Coordinate preventive maintenance and servicing of: Air-conditioning units Pest control Plumbing and electrical requirements Appliances Other household equipment and facilities Maintain a calendar of recurring maintenance requirements. Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, technicians, and service providers. Monitor annual property dues, association dues, real property taxes/amilyar, and other property-related obligations. Maintain organized records of property-related payments and documents. G.  Vehicle Administration Monitor vehicle registration renewal schedules. Coordinate vehicle insurance renewal and related requirements. Maintain records of vehicle documents, insurance policies, registration, and other important information. Coordinate preventive maintenance and servicing schedules, when required. Coordinate with drivers regarding vehicle-related requirements and documentation. Ensure that renewal deadlines and vehicle-related obligations are monitored and completed on time. H.  Financial and Expense Administration Maintain and monitor petty cash for household and personal expenses. Record, organize, and reconcile household-related expenses. Summarize and monitor personal and family credit card expenses. Prepare periodic expense summaries for the CEO/President’s review. Coordinate payment of personal, household, property, vehicle, and family-related expenses. Maintain proper supporting documents and receipts for all expenses. Monitor recurring payments and ensure that no important payment or renewal deadline is missed. Coordinate with accounting, banks, financial institutions, or authorized representatives when required. Assist in monitoring investments and maintaining organized records of investment-related information, transactions, and schedules, as authorized by the CEO/President. I.  Family Office and Administrative Coordination Maintain an organized master calendar covering the CEO/President, spouse, children, household, drivers, properties, travel, and important deadlines. Maintain a centralized tracker for: Bills and payments Insurance renewals Vehicle registration Property dues and taxes School payments Household staff requirements Maintenance schedules Travel arrangements Important family dates Coordinate with external service providers, schools, banks, insurance companies, government agencies, property administrators, and other relevant parties. Follow up on pending personal and family-related matters until completion. Provide regular status updates to the CEO/President.   J.  Confidentiality, Security and Professional Conduct Maintain strict confidentiality over all personal, family, financial, business, travel, and household information. Exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive documents, conversations, transactions, and requests. Do not disclose personal or family information to unauthorized individuals. Maintain professional boundaries and appropriate conduct when dealing with household staff, suppliers, service providers, and third parties. Protect documents, keys, access information, personal records, and other sensitive materials entrusted to the position. Immediately report unusual, sensitive, or potentially significant concerns to the CEO/President. QUALIFICATIONS Educational Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, Hospitality Management, Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred. Candidates with relevant extensive experience in executive assistance, private household management, family office administration, or personal affairs management may also be considered. Experience At least 3–5 years of experience in any of the following: Personal Assistant Executive Secretary Family Office Assistant Private Office Assistant Household/Family Affairs Manager Administrative Officer Executive Concierge Similar high-trust administrative role Experience working directly with executives, business owners, principals, or high-level families is highly preferred. Experience handling travel arrangements, household administration, financial documentation, or family schedules is an advantage. Technical Competencies Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Proficient in using Google Workspace and calendar management tools. Strong ability to maintain trackers, schedules, expense records, and administrative databases. Basic understanding of household financial management and expense reconciliation. Familiarity with government remittance processes such as SSS, Pag-IBIG, and PhilHealth is an advantage. Strong documentation and record-keeping skills. Comfortable coordinating online bookings, travel platforms, payment systems, and service providers. AI-literacy is a great advantage Preferred Additional Qualifications From South - Laguna (Verdana) and Cavite (Vista Verde) A valid driver’s license is an advantage. Willingness to travel when required. Willingness to work at the CEO/President’s residence/private office. Experience working with private families or high-net-worth individuals is an advantage. A strong network of reliable suppliers and service providers is an advantage. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.  Can work Monday to Friday, and as needed during weekends.

review_candidates.title: IT Service Desk Specialist (m/f/d) | Doka Malaysia
review_candidates.description: Doka – an innovative and reliable partner in the construction industry. For over 150 years. As a leading provider of formwork and scaffolding solutions, we understand the challenges our customers face. Our more than 8,400 employees in 54 countries and 150 locations on 5 continents go the extra mile with passion and dedication. Various construction projects worldwide are proof of this. Realize your potential in a supportive, high-performance work environment that is focused on continuous growth. Let's shape the future together. We make it work. Job Description WHAT IF your support kept work running smoothly? From Kuala Lumpur, you will be part of our global IT organization and help colleagues worldwide stay productive through reliable, efficient and user-focused support. The IT Service Desk is the central point of contact between users and the IT organization and ensures professional, efficient and user-oriented handling of IT incidents, service requests and general IT support enquiries. We are looking for an IT Service Desk Specialist who will work as an integrated member of our central IT Service Desk team based at our Headquarters in Amstetten, Austria. The position will be physically located at our Doka office in Kuala Lumpur but will primarily support the global Service Desk organization and its central processes and activities. While occasional support for local or regional IT activities may be required, the primary focus of this role is the global Service Desk organization. Job Description Support the central IT Service Desk in the processing of incidents, service requests and standardized IT activities for users across the global organization. Record, classify, prioritize and process IT tickets based on the IT Service Catalogue and defined ITSM processes. Independently resolve tickets within the defined scope or ensure complete and qualified documentation for handover to the appropriate Service Line or specialist team. Perform Service Desk back-office activities that can be handled independently of direct end-user interaction. Process standardized requests and workflows through the ticketing system, including Joiner, Mover and Leaver processes, access-related requests and other defined Service Desk activities. Support the central Service Desk in restoring normal service operation as quickly as possible and minimizing the business impact of IT incidents. Support the coordination, documentation and communication of Major Incidents according to defined processes. Create, maintain and actively use knowledge articles, solutions, procedures and workarounds to improve resolution quality and enable knowledge sharing across the global IT organization. Work closely with the Service Desk team at Headquarters in Amstetten as well as with other global IT Service Lines and regional IT teams. Contribute to continuous improvement and standardization of Service Desk processes, documentation and operational procedures. Qualifications First professional experience in an IT Service Desk, IT support or technical support environment is preferred. Good understanding of common end-user technologies, Windows environments and Microsoft 365. Experience with ticketing systems and basic knowledge of IT Service Management / ITIL processes is an advantage. Structured and systematic approach to troubleshooting and the ability to work effectively with documented procedures, workflows and knowledge articles. Ability to work independently while being part of an international and geographically distributed team. Strong customer and service orientation with a friendly and professional communication style. Good English skills, both written and spoken, are required for daily collaboration within an international IT organization. Willingness to work in close alignment with the working hours and operational requirements of the global Service Desk organization. Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to our Headquarters in Amstetten, Austria, for initial onboarding as well as occasional training, workshops and team meetings. Additional Information Organizational Setup Work location: Doka Malaysia, Kuala Lumpur Functional assignment: Central IT Service Desk / Corporate IT Main collaboration: IT Service Desk Headquarters, Amstetten, Austria Classification: Restricted Scope: Global Service Desk services and central IT processes Local / Regional IT Support: May be provided occasionally when required, but is not the primary responsibility of this position

Maintain site IT readiness by ensuring end-user devices, meeting room technology, printers, network equipment, and other local technology remain operational. Coordinate with remote IT teams and vendors to resolve complex technical issues and complete activities requiring additional expertise or external resources. Support IT projects, site surveys, office moves, infrastructure activities, and other initiatives requiring onsite technical presence. Maintain knowledge articles, procedures, and documentation while identifying opportunities to improve onsite support processes and service quality. What You Bring Bring 3–5 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, or a related technical role. Demonstrate experience providing onsite enterprise IT support and resolving hardware and software issues. Apply strong knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and workplace technology. Understand basic networking concepts, connectivity troubleshooting, cabling, and network equipment. Demonstrate experience with ITSM tools, preferably ServiceNow, and IT asset management processes. Understand asset lifecycle management, inventory control, and CMDB principles. Communicate effectively in English and the local language. Work independently, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of technical issues through resolution. Collaborate effectively with remote IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders. Maintain a professional, customer-focused approach when supporting employees and business operations. Hold an Associate Degree, technical diploma, or equivalent technical experience. Flexibility to work fully onsite (100% presential), with occasional travel to regional sites as require, with occasional travel to regional sites as required What We Offer Gain international exposure by collaborating with Global IT teams and colleagues across multiple countries. Build your career within a global organization with opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning. Work in a collaborative environment where your technical expertise directly contributes to business operations. Gain exposure to a broad range of technologies, projects, and IT functions. Be part of an inclusive workplace that values collaboration, diversity, and different perspectives. Enjoy competitive local-market compensation and benefits.
